name: Ashmark Gang Lieutenant's Full Colors Set
description: A heavily customized long bomber jacket in deep oxblood synth-leather, the back panel bearing heat-transfer gang sigil work over an internal trauma-plate liner, worn over a fitted black ribknit shirt and straight-cut armored trousers. Wide-platform boots with reinforced toe caps and a concealed blade channel in the left shaft complete the look. Every element signals hierarchy — the sigil placement, the cut, and the specific oxblood colorway are readable as rank to anyone who knows.
functionality: Internal trauma-plate liner provides stab and low-caliber ballistic resistance; concealed blade channel in left boot shaft; armored trouser panels protect knees and shins.
what_it_says: This person runs something, answers to someone above them, and will not hesitate.
manufacturer: Custom — bomber base from Ironclad Rivet Co., modified by Ashmark crew tailors
story_hooks: The sigil on the back has been partially painted over — this person recently switched allegiances and the old colors aren't fully gone.
A new recruit is wearing the same colorway without permission; the lieutenant has to decide how to handle it publicly.

physical_description.visual_profile: A commanding silhouette that reads as street authority — the long bomber creates vertical emphasis, shoulders slightly structured but not rigid. The deep oxblood creates a blood-on-asphalt aesthetic. Worn by someone who expects to be recognized and obeyed.
physical_description.fit: The bomber is tailored slim through the torso with a dropped waist, hitting mid-hip. The ribknit shirt is compression-fit, emphasizing musculature or augmentation. Trousers are straight-cut with deliberate width at the thigh, tapering at the ankle for boot integration. The overall effect is controlled aggression.
physical_description.primary_material: Synth-leather (oxblood) bomber with internal ballistic weave trauma-plate liner. Black ribknit shirt. Reinforced canvas-composite trousers. Boots in treated synthetic leather with chrome-edged toe caps.
physical_description.texture: The synth-leather has a slightly tacky, high-shine finish suggesting expensive treatment. The ribknit is tight and dimensional. Trousers have a matte, utilitarian weave. Boots show a brushed metallic texture at the caps.
physical_description.color_scheme: Deep oxblood red (almost maroon, with dark undertones) as primary. Pure black ribknit and trousers create stark contrast. Silver and chrome accents on boot hardware and sigil heat-transfer work.
closures: Magnetic snap front closure on bomber (silent, tactile)
Full-length side zip on trousers (Tier 3+ quality)
Lace-up boots with integrated ankle strap
distinctive_features: Heat-transfer gang sigil on full back panel — crisp, professional work, not hand-done
Internal trauma-plate visible at open front — reinforced chest protection
Wide collar with subtle chrome piping
Concealed blade channel in left boot shaft — functional, readable as weapon
Platform soles (3-4cm) adding presence and height
Weathering concentrated at cuffs and collar hem — worn but maintained
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3 — working class with corpo-grade customization. The manufacturing is skilled but not bespoke luxury; the trauma plates and blade channels are practical, not ceremonial.
physical_description.cultural_context: Ashmark Gang hierarchy. Wearing this broadcasts: crew affiliation, earned rank, violence literacy, and access to specialized tailors. It says the wearer has killed or been credibly threatened with killing. In GLMZ street politics, this outfit is a resume.
physical_description.condition_typical: Broken-in and maintained. Minor scuffs on toe caps, slight fading at stress points (elbows, knees), but no rips or major damage. The sigil is pristine — it's been refreshed within the last few months. This is someone who respects the uniform enough to maintain it.

image_prompt: A lean, augmented figure in an oxblood synth-leather bomber jacket and black ribknit shirt, standing three-quarter view against a rain-slicked GLMZ alley backdrop. Deep shadows from overhead neon (blue and red bleeding through). The back panel heat-transfer gang sigil catches harsh light, showing crisp detail. Black armored trousers taper into platform boots with visible chrome toe caps. The figure's posture is relaxed but alert — one hand resting near the concealed blade in the left boot. Moody, cinematic lighting emphasizing the oxblood as a statement color. Shot from boots to shoulders. --ar 2:3 --v 6
